_comment: Shared vectors of the Windows volume label rule (NZ1) and the system disk default rule (DN2). VmDiskLayoutTest runs them against lib/vm_disk_layout.php and lib/defaults.php, tests/e2e/tests/disk-label-mirror.test.js against portal/assets/vm-disk-label.js. max and defaults are asserted against the PHP constants. Names are synthetic.
